title: Cambrian / South San Jose：战后独立屋与学区交界
title_en: Cambrian / South San Jose: postwar homes where school districts meet
intro: 95118 在 San Jose 西南，处在 Cambrian 和 Blossom Valley 之间，Blossom Hill Rd、Branham Ln 和 Meridian Ave 是日常主路，SR-85、SR-87 和 Almaden Expressway 都在附近。住房以五十到七十年代的单层 ranch 独立屋为主，地块规整，多为双车位车库，Blossom Valley 一带还散布着七八十年代的联排。Vineland Branch Library 在 Blossom Hill Rd 上，大型购物可以去东南方向的 Oakridge，出门基本靠开车。这个邮编最明显的特点是几个学区在这里交汇，名字相近的街区可能分属不同的学校系统。
intro_en: 95118 sits in southwest San Jose between Cambrian and Blossom Valley, with Blossom Hill Rd, Branham Ln and Meridian Ave as the everyday roads and SR-85, SR-87 and Almaden Expressway close by. Most homes are single-story ranches from the 1950s through the 1970s on regular lots, usually with two-car garages, and Blossom Valley adds scattered townhomes from the 1970s and 1980s. Vineland Branch Library is on Blossom Hill Rd, Oakridge to the southeast handles bigger shopping trips, and getting around mostly means driving. What sets this ZIP code apart is that several school districts meet here, so neighborhoods with similar names can fall under different school systems.
buyer: 学校要放在第一步核对。Pioneer High 属 San José Unified，Branham High 属 Campbell Union HSD，两所学校都在 95118；小学和初中还涉及 San José Unified、Union School District 等，请按完整地址向学区核实，不要采信房源描述。老 ranch 房重点看原始下水管、单层玻璃、屋顶、暖通和加建许可。
buyer_en: Put schools first on your list. Pioneer High is in San José Unified and Branham High is in Campbell Union HSD, and both campuses are in 95118, while elementary and middle schools here also involve San José Unified, Union School District and others. Confirm the full address with the district rather than relying on a listing. On older ranch homes, look at the original sewer line, single-pane windows, roof, HVAC and permits for additions.
seller: 可比成交要先按学区组合分组，再看房型和地块。隔几条街的房子如果分属不同学区，或者一边是独立屋、一边是七八十年代的联排，都不宜放在同一组里比较。把屋顶、管线、下水管的更新时间和加建许可整理好，挂牌时学校信息写到学区和官方查询入口为止。
seller_en: Group comparable sales by school district first, then by home type and lot. Homes a few blocks apart may belong to different districts, and a 1970s townhome should not sit in the same comparison set as a detached house. Have dates for roof, plumbing and sewer work ready along with permits for additions, and keep school information in the listing to the district and its official lookup.
